title: 3-class Cardiff RoBERTa transformer backend
description: Extend the transformer backend to a 3-class head starting with Xenova/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest (Cardiff NLP, ONNX, quantized variant), cached locally after one-time download; labels negative/neutral/positive map directly to neg/neu/pos.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Transformer backend reworked into a model registry: default --sentiment-backend transformer now resolves to the epic-L winner SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions-onnx (28-emotion head mapped to pos/neu/neg via documented GO_EMOTIONS_POSITIVE/GO_EMOTIONS_NEGATIVE sets); the Cardiff 3-class head Xenova/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest (task cc07d6 deliverable) is available as transformer-cardiff, plus transformer-xlmr and the sst2 baseline. Models are driven through AutoTokenizer + AutoModelForSequenceClassification with explicit 512-token truncation (pipeline-level truncation was insufficient: RoBERTa position-embedding ONNX graphs fail past 512 tokens and some repos leave model_max_length unset; 1200-char input clamp added). Quantized q8 variants cached locally after one-time download. Cardiff results on BlackbookM1: tuning accuracy 0.941, held-out 0.615, confusion pos 3/1/0 neu 0/6/3 neg 6/0/7, throughput ~267 msgs/sec, model 120.1 MB.
